composition.rule: RFA-02 delegates request identity, payload, request, result fingerprinting, canonical snapshots, and exact result replay to RFA-01 without re-hashing or translating them.

requiredParticipants: OUTBOX or explicit NO_OUTBOX delivery evidence
atomicBoundary.rule: withLockedTransaction must serialize the same requestKey and commit or roll back every required participant together. Nested domain providers must join this transaction or a savepoint; they must not open an independent commit boundary.

deliveryEvidence.rule: NO_OUTBOX is explicit terminal evidence for operations that intentionally emit no delivery; omission is not accepted.

replay: The adapter must re-read the RFA-01 terminal, typed receipt, and delivery evidence in one locked transaction. RFA-02 requires exact contract shape and result-fingerprint equality before RFA-01 verifies identity, payload, request, result, and returns its detached result snapshot.
uncertainCommit: Only an exact base-constructor TransactionCommitAckAmbiguousError branded by the module-private WeakSet, as checked solely by isTransactionCommitAckAmbiguousError, activates reconciliation after persistence. Plain lookalikes, subclasses, Object.create prototype forgeries, proxies, and throwing prototype traps do not. Deterministic work, persistence, adapter, and RFA-01 errors are rethrown unchanged. readCommitted must use a fresh transaction and re-read every referenced evidence row; only an exact canonical match returns success, while missing, unreadable, or changed evidence fails closed.
adapterResponsibilities: verify the typed receipt exists, is terminal, and has the declared result fingerprint
verify the outbox exists with the declared payload/result binding, or validate the explicit NO_OUTBOX reason
persist and load the complete RFA-02 terminal shape
never expose a partial terminal as undefined or execute work over partial evidence
preserve rollback, restart, and concurrent request-key locking semantics
